feature_order_guard.configuration.title: Feature Order Guard
feature_order_guard.configuration.strate:
What to do with a "Feature order cycle found" crash.
RESOLVE: fix the order with the fewest changes and keep loading.
REPORT_ONLY: write the report, then crash like vanilla.
CRASH: do nothing (pure vanilla).
Needs a game restart.
feature_order_guard.configuration.write_: Write logs/feature_order_guard-report.txt. The log always gets a short summary.
feature_order_guard.command.none: No feature order cycles in this session. Nothing was changed.
feature_order_guard.command.summary: %s cycle(s) in %s biome source(s), %s ordering edge(s) removed.
